name: The Favor I Owe
source:
The Favor I Owe is a story of Ethan and Ava, a happily married couple for over two years, who share the kind of love that feels unshakeable. They’ve built their world together, filled with happiness, those special little moments and obviously a lot of sex.

But now, for the first time, they’re apart. Ethan has been sent away on a two-month project, leaving Ava behind. One of the ways they communicate is through text messages, and the story will be told through these text messages.

So, a happy wife equals a happy life and Ethan seems to have cracked the code and everything is going perfect until Ethan gets a message from his best friend. A woman who once made a great sacrifice for Ethan. A woman who now asks for something that could destroy everything he holds dear. A favor that crosses every line imaginable.

[From [url=https://atherbond.itch.io/the-favor-i-owe-chapter-1]Itch[/url]]
translation:
《我欠的恩情》讲述了伊森和艾娃这对幸福婚姻两年多的夫妇的故事，他们分享着不可动摇的爱。他们共同构建了自己的世界，充满了幸福、那些特别的小时刻，当然还有大量的性爱。

但现在，他们第一次分开了。伊森被派去执行一个为期两个月的项目，留下艾娃。他们交流的方式之一就是通过短信，故事也会通过这些短信来讲述。

所以，一个幸福的妻子等于幸福的生活，伊森似乎已经破解了密码，一切都很顺利，直到伊森收到他最好的朋友的消息。一个曾经为伊森做出巨大牺牲的女人。一个女人现在所要求的东西可能会毁掉他所珍视的一切。这是一个跨越所有可以想象的界限的恩惠。

[来自[url=https://atherbond.itch.io/the-favor-i-owe-chapter-1]Itch[/url]]
